raw.details:
Register for the Noor Hackathon 2026 through the official website https://www.noorhackathon.com/. 

About Noor Hackathon

Get ready to innovate, collaborate, and turn your ideas into impactful solutions at Noor Hackathon 2026, an on-campus hackathon organised at Manav Rachna University, Faridabad, on 2–3 November 2026.

Noor Hackathon brings together passionate college and university students to collaborate, tackle real-world challenges, and develop innovative solutions using technology, creativity, and problem-solving skills.

Whether you are a programmer, designer, entrepreneur, researcher, or creative thinker, Noor Hackathon is an opportunity to work with like-minded innovators, showcase your abilities, and transform ideas into meaningful solutions.

Think boldly. Build creatively. Illuminate the future.

Event Details

  • Event: Noor Hackathon 2026
  • Dates: 2–3 November 2026
  • Venue: Manav Rachna University, Faridabad, Haryana
  • Mode: Offline
  • Registration Deadline: 1 November 2026
  • Early-Bird Registration Fee: ₹400 per team with coupon code NOOREARLY, until 29 October 2026
  • Regular Registration Fee: ₹500 per team, from 30 October to 1 November 2026
  • Competition Format: Two rounds. (Presentation, then prototype)
  • Official Email: contact@noorhackathon.com

Eligibility Criteria

  • The hackathon is open to college and university students.
  • Participants from different colleges and universities are welcome.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed, including teams comprising students from different institutions.
  • Participants must provide accurate personal, academic, and contact details during registration.
  • Every team must follow the team-size limits specified in the official registration form.
  • All participants must comply with the rules, deadlines, and instructions issued by the organisers.

Registration Process.

  • Enter your team name and the required details for the team leader and all team members.
  • Provide the following information for each participant:
    • Full name
    • Course/program
    • College/university name
    • Location
    • Gender
    • Mobile number
    • Email address
    • Current year of study
    • College ID card
  • Complete the team registration fee payment according to the official payment instructions.
  • Submit the payment screenshot and the UTR number or UPI transaction reference number, ensuring that the reference number is clearly visible.
  • Keep the payment reference number for future verification.
  • Once the registration and payment details are verified, registered teams will receive a confirmation email and registration ID.

Important: Registration is considered complete only after the required information and payment details have been submitted according to the organisers' instructions.

Registration Fees

Early Bird: ₹400 per team

Applicable until 29 October 2026.

Regular Registration: ₹500 per team

Applicable from 30 October through 1 November 2026.

The registration fee is charged per team, not per participant. Please complete your registration before the deadline.

Competition Format

Noor Hackathon 2026 will consist of two rounds.

Participants must follow the instructions, deliverables, and submission deadlines announced by the organisers for each round. Details regarding the round-wise process, presentation requirements, and evaluation procedure will be communicated through official event channels.

Teams should be prepared to explain their ideas, demonstrate their approach, and answer questions from the evaluation panel, wherever required.

Judging Criteria

Projects may be evaluated on the following parameters:

  • Innovation: Originality, creativity, and uniqueness of the proposed solution.
  • Technical Feasibility: Practicality, functionality, and technical implementation.
  • Impact: Potential to solve a meaningful problem and benefit the intended users or community.
  • Presentation: Clarity of communication, demonstration, and explanation of the solution.
  • Scalability: Potential for future development, adoption, and expansion.

The detailed evaluation rubric and scoring weightage will be communicated by the organisers.

Rules and Regulations

  • Each team must comply with the official team-size requirements.
  • All registration information must be accurate and complete.
  • Each team is responsible for ensuring that its payment reference number and supporting screenshot are correct and readable.
  • Participants must submit their work within the deadlines and in the formats specified by the organisers.
  • Projects must be created and presented in accordance with the official competition guidelines.
  • Plagiarism, false claims of ownership, fabricated results, and unauthorised use of another team's work are prohibited.
  • Participants must respect fellow participants, mentors, judges, volunteers, and university staff.
  • Any misconduct, disruption, or violation of event policies may result in disqualification at the organisers' discretion.
  • Participants must follow all campus safety, security, and venue regulations.
  • The organisers reserve the right to make reasonable changes to the event schedule or competition arrangements when necessary. Any significant updates will be communicated through official channels.

Important Information

  • The registration deadline is 1 November 2026.
  • Participants should monitor their registered email addresses for confirmation messages and event updates.
  • Participants must retain their registration ID and payment reference number.
  • The detailed schedule, round instructions, submission requirements, and other event announcements will be shared by the organisers.
  • Overnight stay arrangements, where applicable, will be communicated separately.

Join Noor Hackathon 2026

Bring your ideas, form your team, and get ready to create something meaningful.

Noor Hackathon 2026: Illuminate the Future.
